summary: Tested the change to R$ 300,00 for SEFAZ/AL cargo AFTE, frontend and backend. dados-inscricao: the section is titled 'Cargo'. The Polo select and the 'Polo universitário' text are gone. select-vaga has exactly one option, value 1, 'Auditor Fiscal da Administração Tributária Estadual (AFTE)', data-price 300.00, pre-selected. taxa-inscricao-info shows 'Taxa de inscrição: R$ 300,00'. MACEIO/AL is still pre-selected. Desktop E2E passed with no page errors: termos -> inscricao (CPF 52998224725 + RG upload) -> dados-inscricao -> confirmacao (c-vaga = AFTE, Estado Alagoas, Cidade MACEIO/AL) -> inscricao-realizada ('Cargo:' AFTE, 'Valor da Inscrição: R$ 300,00') -> pagamento-pix (Cargo AFTE, Valor R$ 300,00). The PIX key is configured and the EMV contains amount 5406300.00, so a QR code is generated. In the admin API, the UI-created inscription has cargo_titulo AFTE, cargo_codigo 1, valor 300.0 and taxa 'R$ 300,00'. The server also forces 300 when the client sends valor 225. minhas-inscricoes shows the 'Cargo' label with AFTE and Valor R$ 300,00. At 390px: no overflow on dados-inscricao or minhas-inscricoes (scrollWidth 390), and the select is 350px wide. Test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: valor_inscricao returns 225.0, a stale value stored in the db.settings document. The 300.0 code default only applies when no settings exist. The value is not used to compute any amount (admin_routes always uses VALOR_INSCRICAO=300), but the admin panel settings still show R$ 225.

issues: The long AFTE label is truncated inside the native select ('...Tributária Est'). Optional: also show the full cargo name as text below the select.

action_items: Update the stored settings valor_inscricao to 300 in the db, or have GET /api/admin/settings return VALOR_INSCRICAO, so the admin panel shows R$ 300,00.

Remove or update obsolete tests that still expect 225 or 183 UNESP courses: test_cursos_unesp.py, test_vunesp_rebrand.py (test_settings_valor_225 etc.), and possibly test_valor_150.py / test_taxa_120.py.
